route_summary.route_note: Costs more than incipient wetness for the same loading: it needs downstream solid-liquid separation, carries a larger solvent inventory, and loses precursor with the mother liquor. Precursor loss is a raw-material effect the step model does not yet price - only the extra equipment time is captured here.
